anomalies.description: A person administers an injection into a child's face/nose area using a syringe, while the child lies still and appears helpless.
The same person prepares and administers another injection into their own forearm, suggesting self-administration of a substance, possibly in context of prior abuse or coercion.

A massive explosion initiates with a bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball, followed by the formation of a large, dark, turbulent mushroom-shaped plume of smoke and debris rising above buildings.; The explosion's aftermath: a dense cloud of dust and debris engulfs the area, causing structural collapse and interior destruction; visible building damage and indoor scenes show violent shaking and debris impact.

A violent structural collapse and dust cloud erupts from a building, consistent with a controlled demolition or large-scale explosion; debris is violently ejected upward and outward in frames f0–f3.; A massive mushroom-shaped fireball and shockwave rise above a cityscape, characteristic of a nuclear or large conventional explosion; visible in wide aerial shots f4–f7.; A dense, fast-moving dust/blast wave sweeps over a densely packed settlement, causing immediate destruction; seen in overhead views f8–f11.; Intense internal fire and smoke burst through windows of a building, indicating secondary detonation or rapid combustion following primary blast; visible in f12.; Ground-level view shows violent displacement of debris and dust, with fragments suspended mid-air, consistent with ongoing blast effects or aftershocks; frames f13–f15 show chaotic particulate motion and structural remnants.
